lines.text: David takes refuge in the cave of Adullam, and about four hundred men rally around him.
David leaves his parents with the king of Moab, then the prophet Gad tells him to go into Judah.
Saul sits under the tamarisk tree at Ramah with his spear and accuses his servants of conspiring against him.
Doeg the Edomite tells Saul he saw David come to Ahimelech at Nob.
Saul's guards strike down the priests of the LORD, and Doeg kills eighty-five men who wore the linen ephod.

wrong_details.wrong: Saul's guards strike down the priests
wrong_details.true: The king's servants would not lift a hand to strike the priests, so Doeg struck them down
